Cliopatria's Mongol Empire shapes 1260-1293 are the nominal union of the four successor khanates; kept as ok. The uluses before 1294 need the additions batch.
Cliopatria's Chagatai Khanate row is the Duwa khanate to 1346 and the eastern Moghul khanate 1346/47-1462 in one; the western half after 1346 has no row. The moghulistan row begins 1463.
